talentPool.title: Talent Pool
talentPool.subtitle: Blind-screen students who are open to work. Names and photos stay hidden until you reach out.
talentPool.blindNote: Names and photos are hidden to keep screening fair. Reach out through one of your jobs to unlock identity and review the CV.
talentPool.emptyBody: No open-to-work students match your search yet. Try a broader location or clear the search.
talentPool.lockedBody: Your account can't browse the talent pool. Ask your organization admin for access.
talentPool.profileNotVisibleBody: The student may have changed their visibility settings, or you don't have access to it.
talentPool.cvReviewHint: Career details live in this student's CVs. Reach out through a job or open a shared application to review their CV.
